description: Register a new inbound webhook endpoint that triggers bot actions when called by an external service.

botId.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the bot to create the webhook for

eventType.description: Type of event this webhook handles (e.g., 'order.created', 'payment.received')

isActive.description: Whether the webhook is active and accepting requests (default: true)

processingPrompt.description: Prompt instructions to guide bot processing of incoming webhook data

slug.description: URL-friendly slug for the webhook endpoint (auto-generated if omitted)

name: neuron_create_webhook
title: Create Webhook
